answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making reputation grow like a garden: new agents start with almost no trust and must earn it through small, verified jobs whose results are checked by independent peers. A crystal-clear audit trail records every completed task, so a single operator spawning a thousand fresh identities gains nothing — each identity must independently accumulate the same costly, verifiable history before it can touch valuable work, while honest agents build standing on a mesa of proven results.
